we have developed a new method to measure the positioning accuracy of microscale components after their assembly to fabricate micro-assembly sets for MOB.
the micro-assembly platform is a good solution to fabricate complex and heterogeneous optical MEMS with good optical performances.
we have developed a measurement system that allows to measure the positioning accuracy of microscale components with a precision better than 0.01°.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a micro-assembly platform for the realization of micro-optical benches and the measurement of their optical performance.
the development of a measurement system to measure the positioning accuracy of microscale components for the fabrication of micro-optical benches.
the fabrication of MOB by means of a new micro-assembly platform and the measurement of the positioning accuracy of the assembled microcomponents.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
micro-assembly of out-of-plane microcomponents is a promising way to fabricate optical microsystems with high positioning accuracies.

micro-assembly can be used to fabricate optical microcomponents with a very good positioning accuracy, but it is not yet able to compete with conventional fabrication techniques in terms of positioning accuracy.
the presented measurement method allows a precise characterization of the assembly process and is a powerful tool to optimize and improve this process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

micro-assembly can provide optical MEMS with positioning accuracy of a few micrometers and optical performances that are comparable to those of optical components manufactured by lithography and/or polishing.
the positioning accuracy of the assembled microscale components can be characterized with a measurement system based on laser interferometry.
the micro-assembly is an efficient and promising way to fabricate micro- and nano-structures.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the positioning accuracy of microscale components can be measured after assembly and that the positioning accuracy is better than the positioning accuracy of the microcomponents themselves.

micro-assembly can be a good alternative to conventional microfabrication methods to fabricate microscale optical components.
